Surrounded by rolling countryside, it offers countryside views and easy access to nearby amenities in Brampton and Longtown.
description:
A delightful traditional detached single-story cottage that projects charm and character. Boasting a double bedroom, a cosy living room, a well-equipped kitchen, and a convenient shower room, this chocolate-box property is a true gem. Nestled amidst the picturesque hills of the southern uplands, near the Scottish borders, it offers stunning countryside views and a generous plot. Situated within easy reach of the market town of Brampton and Longtown, this location provides access to the Border Forest Park, Northumberland National Park, and Kielder Forest Park. Nearby educational facilities include a primary school nearby and secondary options in Brampton and Carlisle. With the potential for development, subject to planning consent, this peaceful retreat presents an ideal opportunity for those seeking a tranquil lifestyle. Don't miss the chance to own this enchanting property.

Directions Head north on the M6 at Junction 44 and follow the A7 to Longtown. In the town centre take the third right turn signposted to Penton, Netherby and Catlowdy and follow this road through the village of the Moat to a ‘T’ junction adjoining the Bridge Inn where you turn right onto the B6318. Follow the B6318 for approximately 5.5 miles through Catlowdy and Kershope Forest and, as you leave the forest, you will reach a crossroads with a post box and play area at the village of Sleetbeck. Turn left at the crossroads for Bailey and after approximately 1.5 miles turn right for Bailey Mill and the property is situated on the left after about 300 yards along this road.

Services Mains electric and water being connected. Neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested. Drainage is to a septic tank. Any alterations required to meet current regulations are to be the responsibility of the purchaser.

Please note no formal investigation has been carried out as to the operation of the sewerage system and septic tanks, these may not meet the current General Binding Rules 2020 and the property is being sold on this basis. All parties must ensure that their lenders are aware of this before submitting an offer.
